parameters.name: Invocations
parameters.description: Number of invocations of this action. This counter does not include suppressed invocations or invocations that were prevented due to an overlap with a previous invocation of this schedule.

parameters.name: Suppressions
parameters.description: Number of suppressed executions of this action.

parameters.name: Overlaps
parameters.description: Number of executions prevented due to overlaps with a previous invocation of this action.

parameters.name: Failures
parameters.description: Number of failed executions of this action. A failed execution is an execution where at least one action failed.

object.description: This object represents the statistics associated with this object.
